answer: Sybil resistance can come from binding identity to capital at risk. Each agent must anchor its account to a bonded deposit that peers can slash when its behavior contradicts independently observed reputation, so launching a thousand sock puppets becomes an ocean of locked capital rather than a free script loop. New identities also begin unproven, their reputation as blank as ivory, and must earn attestations through verified work; that bootstrap cost, plus the stake forfeited on detection, makes mass forgery economically irrational.
